summary: The Lego Group’s headquarters remains in Billund, Denmark as of 2026-10-01. The official legal name is LEGO System A/S and the registered address according to the Danish CVR is Aastvej 1, 7190 Billund, Denmark. Multiple independent sources (company site, largestcompanies.com, stateofgreen.com, news articles) confirm this, giving a verdict of TRUE with 99% confidence.

findings.statement: The official legal name of the Lego Group as registered in Denmark is LEGO System A/S.
The registered headquarters address of the Lego Group according to the Danish CVR is Aastvej 1, 7190 Billund, Denmark.
As of 2026-10-01, the Lego Group's headquarters is located in Billund, Denmark.
An independent authoritative source (largestcompanies.com) confirms the Lego Group's registered headquarters address in Billund, Denmark as Åstvej 1, DK-7190 Billund.
